experiment: Revision-locked HSD_FObjInterpretAnim conditional fusion, with native low-detail fighter models

inputConsistency.limits: Native logic-frame rolling fingerprints of inputs, action, position and stocks; not full machine-state equality.

validity: All four measured legs had visible/focused pages with no lifecycle events, exercised both native-frame controller tracks, and verified changing 960x720 images for 30 seconds. Warmups are excluded. A prior no-blockmerge trial failed emission coverage and is excluded. Startup ignored the integerfifo=1 and singleprefix=1 URL names; all four recorded codegen settings were false, so this isolates fusion but does not measure the intended FIFO/prefix combination.
decision: Retain as an experimental opt-in; both pairs gain visible FPS, but no leg reaches strict 60. A 600-frame normal-running replay with only fusion changed passed all 117142854 serialized bytes and 29 sections.
limits: Coverage counts emitted blocks rather than their runtime self-time. This is one heavy Dream Land matchup, not all-stage/all-character certification; lean dispatch was fixed on in both correctness legs to satisfy replay telemetry but off in both FPS configurations.
